verdict.rationale: The pricing page is referenced and shows some plan-gated features (export/import, custom strategies, SSO) but the evidence never shows actual published prices or explicit cost drivers like per-seat, MAU, event, or request-based pricing that a PM could use to estimate cost before committing.
